name: Comfwee Café
source:
Welcome to Comfwee Café! Here, you can receive comfort from three gentle waiters.If something is troubling you, the waiters will do their best to cheer you up! All they want is to make you feel better and treat you like you're a part of their family. Though, they barely get customers in their café, so they aren't making any profit... It's up to you to help them and their business!

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/comfwee-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Comfwee咖啡馆！在这里，三位温柔的服务生会给你安慰。如果有什么事情让你烦恼，他们会竭尽所能，让你打起精神！他们只希望你能好受一些，并像家人一样对待你。不过，这家咖啡馆几乎没有客人，根本赚不到钱……帮助他们和这门生意，就看你了！

[摘自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/comfwee-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
